ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the legend in the lower left corner of the figure shows different types of day-night population changes, among which the symbol indicating "fewer by day, more by night" is a vertical-line texture. In the district map, this vertical-line texture mainly appears in the area on the right side of the figure, especially near the place marked ③, and its overall position is toward the east. Reasoning: a bedroom town undertakes the residential function; residents return to their residence at night and go out to work during the day, so it should correspond to an area with "fewer by day, more by night." Judging by the default map direction of north at the top and south at the bottom, west on the left and east on the right, the right side of the figure is the eastern part, so the city's bedroom town is located in the eastern part of this district.
